title: Record one degree-5 sign n=8 parity prefix at 23/16 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Records one nested triangular prefix for the n=8 symbol `(1, 1/8, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16, -1/16, 1/16, 1/16)`. This is the degree-5 sign left open by #4815. No new κ. The selected record stays `60403/20000000`.

The tail `l1` is `1/2`. Every proper prefix has infinity norm at most `3/2`. The largest proper prefix is `23/16`. The first five proper prefixes are `2567/2048`, which is above `5/4`. The next five are `21/16`. The even child stays `(1, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16)`. The quotient is `(1/8, 7/128, -151/2048, 1831/32768)`. The right shear keeps the third entry, so the opening rises from the positive value `2521/2048`. The completed product matches the reordered Toeplitz matrix and has infinity norm `3/2`.

This package branches from main `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`. It does not replay an unmerged predecessor.
